input: A community authority says only their proof method counts; attribute language is impossible, slogans keep absorbing objections, and every answer opens more dependencies.

bridge_terms.D0: The surface discourse contains authority, warrant, ontology, memetic pressure, and dependency signals.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded state preserves those pressures as interacting controls rather than as decorative labels.
bridge_terms.selected_N: The selected noetic frame remains provisional until the live register mix identifies the governing burden.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: The expanded bridge maps the live registers to existing owner choice, held material, burden selection, and reread controls.
bridge_terms.xi: The authority and proof-method pressure changes warrant owner eligibility before evidence release.
bridge_terms.Omega: The attribute-impossibility claim changes predication and ontology owner eligibility.
bridge_terms.mu: The slogan/stabilizer pressure changes burden selection and blocks proof dumping.
bridge_terms.kappa: The dependency pressure changes collapse radius and prevents premature closure.
bridge_terms.Delta-kappa: After the first burden lands, the dependency-radius delta must be reread before STOP/HOLD/PARTIAL/RECURSE.

control_effects.hold_release: Hold evidence and attribute content until warrant, predication, and carrier controls are typed.
control_effects.burden_selection: Select the upstream proof-method and predication burden before downstream content.
control_effects.reread: After the first burden lands, reread whether the carrier and dependency radius still block release.

ir_projection.load_bearing_node: authority/proof-method, predication, carrier, and dependency pressures are all live controls
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: Proof packets, attribute exposition, and downstream evidence are held until the active register controls are ordered.

post_render_gate.cleared_this_pass: the proof-method and predication controls are identified as owners rather than topic labels
post_render_gate.remaining_live_distortions: carrier absorption and dependency-radius pressure remain live after the first control lands
post_render_gate.next_eligible_pass: order the carrier/dependency burden after register reread
